note: ASSUMED demo values, not measurements and not from a cited source. Peak dose rates and durations per flare class were chosen to make the effect visible. A flare itself adds little dose inside a spacecraft; the real hazard is the solar energetic particles (SEP) that follow, and indoor doses are far lower than the X-class numbers here. DONKI supplies the class, magnitude and time only; the dose response is modeled. The hold times are our own assumption.
